_about: Sonora design tokens (Android, Compose). Roles measured from replica/screens (Diffuse 1.1.0.0, tablet, density 2.0) and adapted: the UI sits on top of the live wallpaper, so every background colour below is the WORST CASE, a pure white wallpaper pixel under the scrims in 'scrim'. A darker album art only raises contrast. replica-brand changes values, never names. Check with: python3 replica/design/contrast.py replica/design/tokens.json

_color_notes.bg: page backdrop: wallpaper + scrim.page (0.55 black) over white = #737373
_color_notes.surface: settings card: bg + scrim.card (0.50 black) = #393939 worst case; drawn as black 50%, not this hex
_color_notes.surface-modal: opaque: dialogs, palette picker, music app list, feedback
_color_notes.border: card stroke 2dp (the original: colorOnSurface, white in dark)
_color_notes.track: inactive slider track and unchecked box outline
_color_notes.accent: neutral placeholder. The original's lavender #b0c6ff is Material You dynamic colour, not a brand colour; replica-brand picks Sonora's
_color_notes.divider: white at 40% alpha, decorative, no contrast requirement
_color_notes.text-muted: only inside cards and modals, never straight on bg (3.3:1 there)

font.sans: Manrope (OFL), bundled as res/font; geometric sans doing the job of the original's proprietary Product Sans

body-strong.use: option labels, FAQ questions, track title

_type_notes: Units are sp. The original sets almost everything in 10sp bold uppercase with wide tracking. Sonora keeps uppercase only for card titles and buttons (the look) and moves reading text to 14sp sentence case (legibility, and it is not a copy of their copy style).
_space_notes: dp. Measured in the original: screen gutter 16, card padding 16, gap between cards 12 (6 + 6), child option indent 24, button height 40.

shadow.none: elevation 0: cards are flat and outlined

motion.art-crossfade: 1500ms linear: wallpaper colour change on a new track
motion.reduced: respect ANIMATOR_DURATION_SCALE = 0: no expand animation, crossfade 300ms

layout.two-column-split: left: setup, now playing, configuration. right: experimental, about, help
